notices.title: CONSUMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL statement
notices.trigger: Noncredit home solicitation sale: consumer sale of $25 or more solicited in person at any place other than the seller's business establishment; a sale the consumer initiated by contacting the seller at his business establishment is outside it
notices.format: Under the conspicuous caption CONSUMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL, exact wording; agreement dated the day the consumer actually signs; the FTC 16 CFR 429 form counts as compliance (9:3539(D))
notices.support: A "noncredit home solicitation sale" is a consumer sale involving a cash price of twenty-five dollars or more for goods or services or both
notices.block: R.S. 9:3539 (Form of agreement or offer; statement of consumer's right; compliance)
notices.hold_reason: The block is the whole of R.S. 9:3539 (seller duties, early cancellation, federal-form compliance) around the statement in subsection (B); printing it would put non-notice statute text in the customer's contract.

changes.new: Three business days (R.S. 9:3538); seller may keep a cancellation fee of five percent of the cash price, not over the cash down payment (9:3540(C))
changes.support: The seller may retain as a cancellation fee five percent of the cash price but not exceeding the amount of the cash down payment.

changes.new: Noncredit home solicitation sales: consumer sales of $25 or more solicited in person at any place other than the seller's business establishment, on top of the federal rule
changes.support: A "noncredit home solicitation sale" is a consumer sale involving a cash price of twenty-five dollars or more for goods or services or both

unsure: LA-cancel: the file says whether the 5 percent fee may be kept when the FTC form is used is not answered by the text, so the fee is stated in cancellation.text only.
LA-cancel: the builder only knows 'sold at the customer's home', not whether the sale was solicited away from a business establishment or initiated by the consumer at it.

cancellation.no_work_or_payment_in_window left unchanged: 9:3541(C) says the seller gets no compensation except the cancellation fee for services done before cancellation, which is not a ban on starting work.
